hooks.prompt: Context: $ARGUMENTS. FIRST: Determine if this session involved writing or running tests. If NO test files were created, modified, or executed in this session (e.g. this was a grading, engineering, or debugging session), respond {"ok": true} immediately — this hook only applies to testing sessions. If tests WERE written or run, verify: 1) All requested test files were written and saved (not just planned). 2) Written test files contain meaningful assertions — not just TODO stubs or empty describe blocks. 3) All written tests were executed at least once and their pass/fail status is known and reported to the user. 4) If a coverage target (80%) was specified or checked, coverage was analyzed and the result was reported. 5) No test files contain Svelte 4 patterns (on:click event handlers, export let prop declarations, createEventDispatcher, slot elements, $: reactive declarations) — only Svelte 5 runes are allowed. 6) All test files use TypeScript (lang='ts' in svelte test setup, or .ts file extension). Respond {"ok": true} if all criteria are met, or {"ok": false, "reason": "description of what remains incomplete"} to force continuation.
